purpose: Test whether the expert-specified direct-absolute family-specific A/B compiler image can recover own successful policies when each fit task receives a privileged free Program; this is a reachability oracle, never a deployment route.

information_wall.shared_gradient_tasks: none; fit19 development tasks update only their own privileged diagnostic Program row
information_wall.held5: privileged transform and frozen inference only; zero shared gradient and zero code fitting
oracle_training_inputs: exact language and action-hidden correct-video event anchors
full successful-occupancy eight-phase source-subtracted action response
successful and learner occupancy full-layer source/expert owner responses
detached source target inputs and successful-member target-local LoRA activation effects
fit-task-local privileged free Programs initialized once from the frozen v6 q_pi at fixed correct videos
cross-episode successful train action chunks used only to optimize those diagnostic free Programs
verified-success learner action chunks used only as a secondary free-Program state-support stratum
source, stable-shared and learner-policy counterfactual responses

free_program_oracle.scope: fit19 task-local privileged reachability diagnostic only
free_program_oracle.uncertainty_parameterization: base times exp of 2 times tanh log-scale

model.prior_only_surface: exact complete rank16 gauge-canonical stable shared prior
model.full_process_surface: direct absolute complete rank16 LoRA from family-specific A/B heads; no stable-prior factor residual or bounded rank-mode retraction
model.absolute_factor_heads: family-specific A/B heads preserve content-conditioned amplitude and write every target and rank directly
model.q_pi_gate: member x event x owner content gate, bounded by visible event presence
model.program_content: owner/layer/family are tensor addresses; no additive address embeddings in visible Program values or q_pi factor values
model.compiler_content_path: language, scene, ordered process and uncertainty are content Values; owner/layer/family addresses and numeric rank queries control local reads
model.query_content_modulation: numeric target/rank query multiplicatively modulates cross-attended Program Values; absent process presence selects the exact shared prior
model.factor_head_init_basis: 0.4 times family A/B weight std implied by the 47 gauge-canonical successful-member RMS values; raw head amplitude is retained

data.video_sampling: without replacement deterministic per task visit
data.phase_source: fit19-frozen 350-to-32 whitening of complete 50x7 successful trajectory responses
data.learner_states: 30 frozen fit19 projected-policy trajectories; verified successes full weight and failures member-agreement/outcome weighted

policy_support.horizon_compression: orthonormal DCT low-frequency basis over complete 50-token owner projection and detached target inputs

objective.effective_update: primary gauge-invariant set target: exact BA Frobenius distance from the compiled free Program to every independently successful task member
objective.canonical_factor_warmstart: diagnostic-only compact rank16 SVD gauge distance; zero optimization weight
objective.functional_response: paired complete PI0.5 final-flow plus target-local LoRA activation effects retained as bounded structural anchors
objective.action_grounding: exact PI0.5 flow-matching loss differentiated through the frozen v6 direct-absolute compiler into fit-task-local free Programs only
objective.action_supervision: every fit task receives the same successful-panel base stratum; verified-success learner panels add state support; failed learner actions never produce gradients
objective.reachability_target: gauge-invariant effective-update distance to all independently successful task members plus exact action and multi-state functional support; no deterministic unique P star is defined
objective.target_local_activation_effect: candidate and successful members apply each target B(Ax_ref) to the same detached source input in 38-owner x 4-horizon-basis policy-native output spaces
objective.prior_counterfactual: absent process presence returns the exact stable-prior LoRA; full Programs use one direct absolute output surface

optimization.task_balance_contract: The 228-visit oracle contains exactly twelve visits for every fit task; rows remain cost-balanced within each 114-visit block.
optimization.distributed: manual flat gradient mean, deferred NCCL, task-equal

materialization.sampling: fixed correct action-hidden videos without replacement
materialization.output: fit19 use one task-local free-Program rank16 LoRA; held5 remain frozen q_pi diagnostics; no free Program is deployable

arms: fit free-Program compiled or held frozen-q_pi compiled
gate2.failure_action: stop before q_V; repair the earliest q_pi/compiler/support interface instead of tuning rank, seed, dtype, or tiny LR sweeps
